method: Opened before-contact, after/before-contact, full Nikon before+after, and all6 1:1 local panels; derived numeric support in concrete-findings and ROI metrics
reviewer: assistant visual inspection, not user preference or calibrated monitor judgment

photos.coverage: white petals, fine petal boundaries and dark green backdrop
photos.local: Petal texture remains visible; background becomes much darker and less green. No local stripe boundary visible. Small newly zero-valued output channels exist, not explainable solely by pre-existing master endpoints.
photos.highlights: No new max-code output channels; neutral petal accuracy unmeasured

photos.coverage: snow/white packaging, red and blue wrapping, small dark details
photos.local: Snow appears slightly cooler/darker; packaging shadows become harder to distinguish. No obvious local band seam.
photos.highlights: Snow is high-reflectance subject, not uniformly sensor-saturated strong-highlight ground truth

photos.coverage: pink/red saturated tulips with bright backlight and dark petal gradients
photos.local: Dark petals show deeper shadows and warmer/redder appearance; brightest background/petals already have green-channel master max endpoints. Fine grain-like source noise is present even though film grain is disabled.
risks: existing frontend highlight clipping confounds bright-petal hue judgment
photos.highlights: Prior final production master G=1 fraction about1.053%, not sensor saturation diagnosis

photos.coverage: limited arm/hand skin, magenta shirt, hair/bright sky edge
photos.local: Arm/hand darkens but no obvious abrupt isolated skin hue discontinuity in inspected crop. Hair shadows deepen, bright sky becomes greyish/cooler.
photos.highlights: Blue-channel master max fraction about3.293%, so sky hue cannot be attributed only to film backend

photos.coverage: pink/white flowers and greens, vehicles, bright sky/building edges
photos.local: Flower-bed shadow regions lose separation and contain more black points. Building boundary remains continuous with no whole/stream seam. Many bright source channels already clipped, separate from new output zero endpoints.
risks: 11562 endpoint-free/interior-input pixels acquire at least one output zero
photos.highlights: Blue-channel prior master max fraction about4.437%, output no65535 channels

photos.coverage: dusk silhouette, wires and deep vehicle shadow
photos.local: Vehicle shadow becomes a near-uniform blue-grey floor: source relative median luma rises but spatial variation collapses. Silhouette/sky boundary continuous; no observed stream seam.
risks: black floor/relative shadow contrast regression candidate
photos.highlights: No strong highlights in this sample; do not generalize from silhouette
